task.maid_rpg_task.maid_tree.desc: The maid will cut down the logs around her and plant saplings.
task.maid_rpg_task.mage_task.desc: The maid will use elemental magic with a gohei with special habilities she will deal big area or single damage but she will have low health.
task.maid_rpg_task.locate.desc: The maid can locate the some structure or your home with specific items.
task.maid_rpg_task.support.desc: The maid will revive nearby bleeding player and give positive effects for team.
task.maid_rpg_task.dps_task.desc: The maid will deal big damage to enemies but have low health.
task.maid_rpg_task.tank_task.desc: The maid will receive damage for allies and have high health but low damage.
task.maid_rpg_task.master_maid.desc: The maid will combine support and attack roles with high damage output.
item.maid_rpg_task.master_soul_spell.too: Equip in a maid's bauble slot to unlock multi-retract on the Smart Slab.
Right-click a baubled maid with empty slab → retracts up to 4 nearby baubled maids at once.
Shift+right-click a baubled maid (slab full or empty) → retracts that one maid and adds her to the slab, even if others are already inside.
Right-click a block → places all retracted maids at once.
Shift+right-click a block → places only the selected maid.
Hold slab + press Up/Down → cycle through retracted maids.
item.maid_rpg_task.master_soul_spell.no_: No nearby maids with this bauble equipped found
maid_rpg_task.config.title: Maid RPG Task Config
maid_rpg_task.config.revive.enable.toolt: Enable or disable the revive task entirely.
maid_rpg_task.config.revive.aggro.toolti: When true, nearby hostile mobs will aggro and target the maid while she is reviving a bleeding player.
maid_rpg_task.config.revive.totem.toolti: When true, the maid can use a Totem of Undying placed in her bauble inventory to instantly revive the owner player.
maid_rpg_task.config.revive.cooldown_ena: When true, the revive ability is limited by resources.
maid_rpg_task.config.revive.support_cool: Cooldown in ticks before a support maid can revive again after a successful revive. Default: 12000 (10 minutes)
maid_rpg_task.config.functions.master.to: Enable or disable the master maid task.
maid_rpg_task.config.balance.survival_ba: Quick preset toggle. When true, overwrites all tuning fields below with balanced values at load time.
maid_rpg_task.config.tank.ally_damage_ta: Fraction of a hit that allies receive when a tank maid is nearby. Default: 0.5
maid_rpg_task.config.tank.tank_absorbs.t: Fraction of the original ally hit that is redirected to the tank. Default: 0.5
maid_rpg_task.config.tank.tank_direct_re: Fraction by which the tank's OWN incoming damage is reduced. Default: 0.5
maid_rpg_task.config.tank.stun_damage_de: Amplifier of the Damage Decrease effect applied to enemies during tank stun. Default: 11
Cooldown in ticks between stun ability uses. Default: 200
maid_rpg_task.config.tank.stun_balanced_: Extra ticks added to the stun cooldown when survival_balanced=true. Default: 20
maid_rpg_task.config.support.strengthene: Strengthened amplifier for allies in combat. Default: 6
maid_rpg_task.config.support.defence_up_: Defence Up amplifier for allies in combat. Default: 8
maid_rpg_task.config.support.damage_decr: Damage Decrease amplifier applied to enemies. Default: 3
maid_rpg_task.config.support.enable_heal: When true, the support maid can cast healing circles on injured allies.
maid_rpg_task.config.support.heal_thresh: HP percentage below which an ally triggers a healing circle. Default: 0.5
maid_rpg_task.config.support.heal_amount: Percentage of max health restored by the healing circle. Default: 0.25
maid_rpg_task.config.support.heal_cooldo: Cooldown in ticks between healing circle casts per target. Default: 600
Visual style of the healing circle. Valid: spiral, end_rod, entity_effect, cycle
maid_rpg_task.config.support.heal_requir: When true, the support maid must have XP to cast healing circles. Default: true
maid_rpg_task.config.support.damage_decr: When true, the support/master maid must have XP to apply the Damage Decrease debuff. Default: false
maid_rpg_task.config.support.buff_requir: When true, the support/master maid must have XP to apply ally buffs. Default: true
maid_rpg_task.config.support.xp_cost.too: Amount of XP drained per tick (every 20 ticks) when in combat. Default: 1
maid_rpg_task.config.support.heal_outsid: When true, healing circles can trigger outside combat. Default: false
maid_rpg_task.config.support.flat_heal.t: When true, heal_amount / large_entity_heal_amount / master heal_amount are used as flat HP values instead of percentages of max health. Default: false
maid_rpg_task.config.support.large_entit: Entities with max health at or above this value use large_entity_heal_amount instead of heal_amount. Default: 60
Percentage of max health restored for large entities (at or above health threshold). Default: 0.20
maid_rpg_task.config.master.enable_heali: When true, the master maid self-heals via a healing circle when injured.
maid_rpg_task.config.master.heal_thresho: HP percentage below which the master maid triggers self-heal. Default: 0.5
Percentage of max health restored per self-heal. Default: 0.25
maid_rpg_task.config.master.heal_cooldow: Cooldown in ticks between self-heal casts. Default: 400
maid_rpg_task.config.mage.spell_cooldown: Minimum ticks between elemental spell casts. Default: 400
Maximum ticks between elemental spell casts. Default: 520
maid_rpg_task.config.mage.ice_spike_redu: Duration in ticks of the Reduced Healing effect applied by Ice Spike. Default: 1000
Amplifier of the Reduced Healing effect applied by Ice Spike. Default: 8
maid_rpg_task.config.mage.bypass_totem.t: When true, elemental spells bypass Totem of Undying. Default: false
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.base_attack_boo: Fraction added to the DPS maid's attack damage via MULTIPLY_TOTAL. Default: 0.35
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.offhand_attack_: Additional MULTIPLY_TOTAL bonus when the DPS maid wields a sword or axe in the offhand. Default: 0.15
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.attack_speed_bo: Fraction added to the DPS maid's attack speed via MULTIPLY_TOTAL. Default: 0.30
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.leech_enabled.t: When true, the DPS maid has a 5% chance on each hit to steal one beneficial effect.
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.leech_max_stack: Maximum number of stolen effects the maid can hold at once. Default: 5
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.leech_duration_: Duration in ticks that a stolen effect lasts on the maid. Default: 6000
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.leech_steal_whi: When true, only effects in dps.leech_steal_list can be stolen.
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.leech_steal_lis: List of effect resource locations used by dps.leech_steal_whitelist_mode (e.g. minecraft:fire_resistance).
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.leech_cleanse_w: When true, only effects in dps.leech_cleanse_list are removed from the target.
maid_rpg_task.config.dps.leech_cleanse_l: List of effect resource locations used by dps.leech_cleanse_whitelist_mode.
maid_rpg_task.config.downsides.dps_healt: When true, DPS maid has reduced max health. Default: true
maid_rpg_task.config.downsides.tank_atta: When true, Tank maid attacks slower and deals less damage. Default: true
maid_rpg_task.config.downsides.mage_heal: When true, Mage maid has reduced max health. Default: true
maid_rpg_task.config.downsides.support_c: When true, Support maid can attack enemies. Default: false
maid_rpg_task.config.bauble.master_soul_: If true, the Master Soul Spell bauble can be crafted at the altar in survival.
If true, the alternate Master Soul Spell altar recipe is enabled.
